item.title: MY First Post
item.description:
Hi, I’m Ian. There are many first-posts out there, but this one is mine. I’m proud of this post. I’m proud of it because there are some other ‘firsts’ that accompany this post.

‘My first git-commit’

‘My first web-site’

‘My first time using hugo’

and probably some other firsts I’m not thinking about at the moment…

I have been training/working in the realm of Information Technology for years. Frankly, I was quite half-baked in these skills. Over the last year and some change, I’ve been working on building and refining my skills, finding a concentration for these skills (Cybersecurity), and putting my nose to the grind-stone. I’m proud of that and I’m proud of this post. I’m sure the next one will be just a little better.
